Gaps:

1. Webhook deliveries to apps are healthy (install-webhooks)
   2 active endpoints, 1 failing, 3 events dropped after 24 h in total
   fix:  Check the failing endpoints (GET /admin/v1/apps/{slug}/webhooks): fix the receiver or its URL, then send a test event.
   docs: https://github.com/marunsct/Platform/blob/main/docs/guide/readiness.md#install-webhooks

2. Access is reviewed at least quarterly (install-access-review)
   no access review recorded
   fix:  Review operators, tenant owners and admins, then record it: POST /admin/v1/evidence {"kind":"access-review","passed":true,"details":{...}}.
   docs: https://github.com/marunsct/Platform/blob/main/docs/guide/readiness.md#install-access-review
   maps to: SOC 2 CC6.2; SOC 2 CC6.3; ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5.18

3. Each organisation has a security policy (tenant-security-policy)
   1 of 2 tenants fail: globex
   fix:  Owners or admins set one in the portal (Security) or with PUT /v1/tenants/{tid}/security-policy.
   docs: https://github.com/marunsct/Platform/blob/main/docs/guide/readiness.md#tenant-security-policy
   maps to: SOC 2 CC6.1

4. Organisations require multi-factor authentication (tenant-mfa)
   1 of 2 tenants fail: globex
   fix:  Set require_mfa: true in the tenant's security policy.
   docs: https://github.com/marunsct/Platform/blob/main/docs/guide/readiness.md#tenant-mfa
   maps to: SOC 2 CC6.1; ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.5

5. Organisations limit session length and idle time (tenant-session-limits)
   1 of 2 tenants fail: globex
   fix:  Set session_max_age and idle_timeout in the tenant's security policy.
   docs: https://github.com/marunsct/Platform/blob/main/docs/guide/readiness.md#tenant-session-limits
   maps to: SOC 2 CC6.1; ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.5

6. Company invitations are limited to the company's domains (tenant-invite-domains)
   1 of 2 tenants fail: globex
   fix:  Set allowed_email_domains in the tenant's security policy.
   docs: https://github.com/marunsct/Platform/blob/main/docs/guide/readiness.md#tenant-invite-domains
   maps to: SOC 2 CC6.2; ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5.16

7. Company audit logs stream to the company's own systems (tenant-audit-streaming)
   1 of 2 tenants fail: acme
   fix:  Add an audit destination in the portal (Audit) or with POST /v1/tenants/{tid}/audit/sinks, and keep it delivering.
   docs: https://github.com/marunsct/Platform/blob/main/docs/guide/readiness.md#tenant-audit-streaming
   maps to: SOC 2 CC7.2; ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.15
